# Wegic

> > Wegic is an AI-powered website builder that enables users to create professional, high-converting websites in minutes without coding.

Wegic specializes in no-code AI website creation with industry-specific templates and tools for portfolios, small businesses, and specialized services. The platform emphasizes quick setup, responsive design, and SEO optimization across diverse business categories.

## Key Topics

- Quick setup
- Small business solutions
- Industry-specific templates
- AI website design
- Portfolio showcase
- Website templates
- Business growth
- Drag-and-drop builder
- Mobile optimization
